pairs: Et misit rex Antiochus filius Demetrii epistolas ab insulis maris Simoni sacerdoti,
And king Antiochus, the son of Demetrius, sent letters from the islands of the sea to Simon,
the priest and leader of the nation of the Jews,
And these continued in this way:
“King Antiochus to Simon, the great priest,
and to the people of the Jews: greetings.
Quoniam quidem pestilentes obtinuerunt regnum patrum nostrorum,
Since certain pestilent persons have obtained the kingdom of our fathers,
et restituere illud sicut erat antea:
to vindicate the kingdom and to restore it,
just as it was before. And so, I have chosen a great army,
and I have built ships of war.
Volo autem procedere per regionem ut ulciscar in eos,
I intend to pass through the region,
et qui desolaverunt civitates multas in regno meo.
so that I may take revenge on those who have corrupted our country and who have desolated many cities in my kingdom.
Nunc ergo statuo tibi omnes oblationes, quas remiserunt tibi ante me omnes reges, et quæcumque alia dona remiserunt tibi:
Now, therefore, I confirm to you all the oblations that all the kings before me have remitted to you, and whatever other gifts they remitted to you.
et permitto tibi facere percussuram proprii numismatis in regione tua:
And I permit you to make a striking of your own coins for your country.
Moreover, let Jerusalem be holy and free.
And all the weapons that have been made,
and the fortresses that you have constructed,
And all that is owed to the king,
and what should belong to the king in the future,
from this time and for all time,
et in totum tempus remittuntur tibi.
when we have obtained our kingdom,
and the temple with great glory,
ita ut manifestetur gloria vestra in universa terra.
so much so that your glory shall be made manifest in all the earth.”
Anno centesimo septuagesimo quarto exiit Antiochus in terram patrum suorum,
In the one hundred and seventy-fourth year, Antiochus went into the land of his fathers,
et convenerunt ad eum omnes exercitus,
and all the armies came over to him,
ita ut pauci relicti essent cum Tryphone.
so that few were left with Trypho.
Et insecutus est eum Antiochus rex,
And king Antiochus followed him as he fled along the sea coast
et venit Doram fugiens per maritimam:
sciebat enim quod congregata sunt mala in eum,
For he knew that evils had gathered together upon him,
and that his troops had forsaken him.
et applicuit Antiochus super Doram cum centum viginti millibus virorum belligeratorum,
And Antiochus took up a position above Dora,
with one hundred and twenty thousand men of warfare and eight thousand horsemen.
and the ships drew near by sea.
et vexabant civitatem a terra et mari,
And they assailed the city by land and by sea,
et neminem sinebant ingredi vel egredi.
and they permitted no one to go in or out.
and those who had been with him,
came from the city of Rome,
habentes epistolas regibus et regionibus scriptas,
having letters written to the kings and the regions,
in which was contained these things:
Legati Judæorum venerunt ad nos amici nostri,
The ambassadors of the Jews, our friends,
came to us, to renew the former friendship and alliance,
missi a Simone principe sacerdotum et populo Judæorum.
having been sent from Simon, the leader of the priests and the people of the Jews.
Attulerunt autem et clypeum aureum mnarum mille.
And they also brought a shield of gold of over a thousand pounds.
it was pleasing to us to write to the kings and the regions,
that they should do no harm to them,
et ut non ferant auxilium pugnantibus adversus eos.
and that they should bear no assistance to those fighting against them.
Visum autem est nobis accipere ab eis clypeum.
And it seemed good to us to receive the shield from them.
Si qui ergo pestilentes refugerunt de regione ipsorum ad vos,
If, therefore, those who are pestilent have taken refuge with you from their region,
hand them over to Simon, the leader of the priests,
ut vindicet in eos secundum legem suam.
so that he may give a verdict to them according to their law.”
Hæc eadem scripta sunt Demetrio regi,
These same things were written to king Demetrius,
Exemplum autem eorum scripserunt Simoni principi sacerdotum, et populo Judæorum.
Moreover, they wrote a copy of these things to Simon, the leader of the priests and the people of the Jews.
Antiochus autem rex applicuit castra in Doram secundo,
But king Antiochus positioned his camp near Dora a second time,
moving his hand against it continually,
et misit ad eum Simon duo millia virorum electorum in auxilium,
And Simon sent two thousand chosen men to him as auxiliaries,
And he was not willing to receive them,
sed rupit omnia, quæ pactus est cum eo antea,
but he broke all of the pact that he made with him before,
and he alienated himself from him.
Et misit ad eum Athenobium unum de amicis suis,
And he sent to him Athenobius,
and the stronghold that is in Jerusalem,
which are cities of my kingdom.
et fecistis plagam magnam in terra,
and you have caused a great scourging in the land,
et dominati estis per loca multa in regno meo.
and you have become ruler throughout many places in my kingdom.
Nunc ergo tradite civitates quas occupastis,
Now, therefore, hand over the cities that you occupy,
et tributa locorum in quibus dominati estis extra fines Judææ:
and the tributes of the places where you have become ruler beyond the borders of Judea.
date pro illis quingenta talenta argenti,
give me for them five hundred talents of silver,
and for the destruction that you have caused,
and for the tributes of the cities,
et tributorum civitatum alia talenta quingenta:
Et venit Athenobius amicus regis in Jerusalem,
came to Jerusalem and saw the glory of Simon,
and his splendor in gold and silver,
And he repeated the words of the king to him.
nor do we hold anything foreign,
but we hold the inheritance of our fathers,
quæ injuste ab inimicis nostris aliquo tempore possessa est.
which was for some time unjustly possessed by our enemies.
In truth, since we have the opportunity,
we claim the inheritance of our fathers.
And as to Joppa and Gazara,
ipsi faciebant in populo plagam magnam,
they brought a great scourging on the people and our country.
we will give one hundred talents.”
Et non respondit ei Athenobius verbum.
And Athenobius did not respond a word to him.
Reversus autem cum ira ad regem,
But, returning with anger to the king,
he reported to him these words,
and all that he had seen.
et iratus est rex ira magna.
And the king became angry with a great anger.
Tryphon autem fugit navi in Orthosiada.
But Trypho fled by ship to Orthosia.
Et constituit rex Cendebæum ducem maritimum,
And the king appointed Cendebeus as commander of the seacoast,
et exercitum peditum et equitum dedit illi.
and he gave him an army of foot soldiers and horsemen.
Et mandavit illi movere castra contra faciem Judææ:
And he commanded him to move with his camp against the face of Judea.
And he commanded him to build up Kedron,
and to barricade the gates of the city,
and to make war against the people.
And Cendebeus passed through to Jamnia,
and he began to provoke the populace,
and to take the people captive,
Et collocavit illic equites et exercitum,
And he stationed horsemen and an army there,
so that they could go out and travel through the ways of Judea,
as the king appointed him to do.
